parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive messaging application that is used to receive the message.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.description: The message body. It can be up to 15 KB in length.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description:
The data center, which must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Valid values:

- cn-shanghai: Shanghai
- ap-southeast-1: Singapore

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the group that receives the message.

> Make sure that the specified GroupId is available. Otherwise, a ResourceNotExist error is returned.

parameters.name: MsgTid
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the message. This parameter is used to delete the message. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length.

parameters.name: MsgType
parameters.description: The message type. The total number of message types sent within a single group cannot exceed 30.

parameters.name: NoCache
parameters.description: Specifies whether to disable message caching to the list of the latest messages in the group. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is cached.

parameters.name: NoStorage
parameters.description: Specifies whether to disable message storage. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is stored for a validity period of 30 days. You can find the message in the response of the ListLiveMessageGroupMessages operation. If you do not need to store the message, set this parameter to true.

parameters.name: SenderId
parameters.description: The ID of the user who sends the message. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits.

parameters.name: SenderMetaInfo
parameters.description: The additional information about the user who sends the message. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length.

parameters.name: StaticsIncrease
parameters.description: The contribution of the message to the increase in the number of messages of this type. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.description:
The weight of the message. Default value: 1.

- For low-priority messages such as likes, you can set the weight to 1.
- For regular text messages such as bullet comments, you can set the weight to 5.
- For high-priority messages such as red envelopes and gifts, you can set the weight to 1000000.
